heroSummary: Miami-Dade County Public Schools starts classes on Thursday, August 13, 2026, and the last day of school is Thursday, June 3, 2027. Spring break runs March 22–26, 2027. A teacher planning day follows on March 29, so students return Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: What are teacher planning days in Miami-Dade?
calendarFaqs.a: Teacher planning days in M-DCPS are days when staff work but students do not attend school. They appear on the district calendar separately from state and federal holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after spring break?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break runs March 22–26, 2027. Monday, March 29 is a teacher planning day, so students return Tuesday, March 30, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Which M-DCPS calendar applies to my student?
calendarFaqs.a: Most M-DCPS students follow the traditional elementary and secondary calendar shown on this page. Technical colleges, adult education programs, and juvenile justice programs use separate official calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: How does M-DCPS handle calendar changes after hurricane closures?
calendarFaqs.a: M-DCPS announces school closures and any resulting makeup-day changes through official district notices. Check the district calendar page after a weather-related closure for the latest schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Are M-DCPS calendars available in Spanish or Haitian Creole?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. M-DCPS publishes official calendar PDFs in English, Spanish, and Haitian Creole. The language versions are available from the district calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Miami-Dade ICS file update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Check the official M-DCPS calendar page for later revisions.

calendarNotes: The 2026–27 Miami-Dade school year begins Thursday, August 13, 2026, and ends Thursday, June 3, 2027. Spring break runs March 22–26; because March 29 is a teacher planning day, students return Tuesday, March 30. With the weekend before spring break and the planning day after it, students have 10 consecutive calendar days away from school.
